# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Audited the two pending habitat-registry amendments and confirmed the checked-out base already satisfies them: `ChangePhotoperiod` is no longer classified as a habitat-registry-affecting action, and the legacy algae colonizable-area helper/call site already document that configurable hardscape is intentionally omitted until `tanksim-6e5.5.3` migrates algae to the habitat registry. Because those fixes were already present in the current checkout, I made no further code edits and used this round to verify the behavior with targeted tests.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the pending-amendment touch points in the habitat action classification and legacy algae colonizable-area helper to determine whether any new code changes were still required.
2. [Completed] Confirmed the current checkout already contains both requested amendments, so no additional implementation edits were necessary in this round.
3. [Completed] Ran targeted validation covering habitat-registry action classification plus representative algae and photoperiod-driven end-to-end behavior to verify the already-landed fixes remain green.

## Validation Evidence

- Inspection confirmed `crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs` no longer includes `ChangePhotoperiod` in `PlayerAction::affects_habitat_registry()`.
- Inspection confirmed `crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs` and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/algae_growth.rs` already contain the requested legacy-hardscape omission note/TODO pointing downstream habitatization work at `tanksim-6e5.5.3`.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test habitat_registry` passed (33 tests), including `photoperiod_action_does_not_mark_habitat_registry_dirty`.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test plant_algae_integration algae_light_off_causes_biomass_decline -- --exact` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test end_to_end sad_lights_off_plant_decline -- --exact` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation was targeted rather than full-workspace; I reran the habitat-registry suite plus representative algae and end-to-end lighting coverage, not the entire repository test matrix.
- A broader `cargo test -p tank_core --test habitat_registry --test plant_algae_integration` attempt still hits 5 existing `plant_algae_integration` failures unrelated to these pending-amendment checks.
- The worktree still contains unrelated pre-existing changes in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs`, `crates/tank_core/tests/cycling.rs`, `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs`, and `.ralph-burning/`, which I left untouched.
